classificationMethod.rgbSpace: Native decoded8-bit encodedRGB. PNG profiles/lighting are not calibrated original albedo.
classificationMethod.mainSelection: Alpha>=128 visible core. Alpha>=16 diagnostics also supplied; transparent/near-invisible RGB excluded from chroma classification.
classificationMethod.chroma: max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B) in8-bit encodedRGB. HSV saturation = chroma/max(R,G,B). Non-dark diagnostics exclude maxRGB<32 to limit dark-code saturation inflation.

classes.quasi-neutral-low-chroma: maxchroma<=6 OR mean<=3,p95<=6,and fraction(chroma>24)<=0.001. Can retain tiny tint/residue; not mathematically grayscale unless exact-achromatic.
classes.near-neutral-with-color-accents-or-tint: Other images with meanchroma<=6,p95<=12,and fraction(chroma>24)<=0.02. Colored lenses/marks or weak material tint may remain; semantic ownership is not inferred.

limitations: Automatic encodedRGB classification is an inventory screen, not a perceptual or human artistic approval.
A nominally grayscale source can have low PBR lighting/material RGB differences; a near-neutral average can conceal a few colored lenses/glyphs. Maximum and colored fractions are therefore kept.
No attempt to infer semantic eye, material, paint, emitter or wearer masks from pixel colors.
Faint alpha fringe is measured separately and left unchanged. No crop, re-encode, resized export, color transform or generated image was written.
